name: MonarchLeaderboard
title: Leaderboard
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows with androidx.compose.foundation.clickable, MonarchAvatar, MonarchProgress (androidx.compose.material3.LinearProgressIndicator), MonarchDeltaIndicator, MonarchBadge, MonarchSkeleton, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchInlineErrorRetry
summary: A ranked list for dashboards: rank, avatar, name, value, an optional change and a bar relative to the leader, with ties sharing a rank and the viewer's own row tagged.
whenToUse: On a dashboard that compares a few people, teams or things by one figure (tickets solved per agent, reply time per team), especially when viewers want to see where they stand.
whenNotToUse: For many columns per entry, use a data table. For plain ranked bars without people or ranks, use MonarchBarList. For a single figure, use a metric.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchLeaderboard(entries: List<MonarchLeaderboardEntry>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, sort: MonarchBarListSort = MonarchBarListSort.None, label: String? = null, valueLabel: String? = null, changeComparison: String? = null, changeGoodDirection: MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.Up, showAvatars: Boolean = true, showBars: Boolean = true, highlightTop: Boolean = false, limit: Int? = null, total: Int? = null, loading: Boolean = false, loadingRows: Int = 5, errorMessage: String? = null, retrying: Boolean = false, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onShowMore: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSelect: ((MonarchLeaderboardEntry) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchLeaderboardLabels = MonarchLeaderboardLabels())

public class MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name: String, value: Double, id: String? = null, display: String? = null, secondary: String? = null, image: Painter? = null, seed: String? = null, avatarShape: MonarchAvatarShape = MonarchAvatarShape.Circle, change: Double? = null, badge: String? = null, badgeTone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, current: Boolean = false)
public class MonarchLeaderboardLabels(you: String? = null, empty: String? = null, loading: String? = null, retry: String? = null, more: ((Int) -> String)? = null, rank: ((Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: entries
options.description: The entries, best first, or set sort.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the board.

options.name: sort
options.description: Descending ranks the largest value first, Ascending the smallest (response times), None keeps the order given. Equal values share a rank.

options.name: label
options.description: Names the board for TalkBack, "Top agents by tickets solved".

options.name: valueLabel
options.description: What the value counts, read after it: "42 tickets solved".

options.name: changeComparison
options.description: The period every change compares with, "vs last week".

options.name: changeGoodDirection
options.description: Which direction of change is good, for every row.

options.name: showAvatars
options.description: Shows the 24dp avatars.

options.name: showBars
options.description: Shows a bar under each name, its length relative to the largest value shown.

options.name: highlightTop
options.description: Puts ranks 1 to 3 on a filled accent marker.

options.name: limit
options.description: Shows at most this many rows. null, 0 or less shows all.

options.name: total
options.description: How many entries exist when entries is already a top N; adds "N more".

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows placeholder rows instead of the list.

options.name: loadingRows
options.description: The number of placeholder rows; at least one.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Replaces the list with this failure.

options.name: retrying
options.description: The retry is running: the Retry button shows its busy state.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes a value without display. null writes a number in the current locale.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Repeats a failed load: adds a Retry button to the error.

options.name: onShowMore
options.description: Makes "N more" a button, for example to open the full report.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Makes each row a button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings.

states.name: ready
states.description: Ranked rows; equal values share a rank.

states.name: current
states.description: The viewer's row on the accent subtle background with the accent border, tagged "(you)".

states.name: top three
states.description: With highlightTop, ranks 1 to 3 sit on a filled accent circle.

states.name: loading
states.description: Placeholder rows, one element read as "Loading ranking".

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState, "Nothing to rank yet".

states.name: failed
states.description: The message with a Retry button when onRetry is given, or the message in the danger text color as a polite live region.

appearance: Names and values in the default text color; ranks, secondary lines and the "(you)" tag in the muted text color. Bars are MonarchProgress: the accent solid fill on the emphasis track. The current row uses the accent subtle background and the accent border. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes come from these roles.
platformNotes: The parity map names a LazyColumn; a board shows a handful of rows inside a dashboard that already scrolls, and a LazyColumn cannot be nested in a vertically scrolling parent, so the rows are a Column; for hundreds of entries use limit and onShowMore. The web names become links with href and "N more" links to moreHref; on Android, as on iOS, rows and "N more" call onSelect and onShowMore and the app navigates. The web secondary line and badge take any content; here they are strings, the badge drawn as a MonarchBadge. Each entry's change is a ratio, with the comparison and good direction set once for the board. The web's format and notation become formatValue, the same writer MonarchBarList takes, so no metric format type is added; the sort reuses MonarchBarListSort. Compose has no ordered-list role, so each row speaks its rank. iOS moves the value under the name at the largest text sizes; on Android the name wraps beside the value.
accessibility: Each row is one TalkBack element read in order: "Rank 1:", the name, "(you)", the badge, the secondary line, the value with its valueLabel ("42 tickets solved") and the change.
Avatars and bars are hidden; the name and the number with its unit carry the data.
The viewer's row is marked in words, not only by its tint.
With onSelect each row is a button at least 48dp high.
The placeholder rows are one element named "Loading ranking".
The board is a traversal group named by label.
An error without retry is a polite live region.
edgeCases: Equal values share a rank and the next rank skips: 1, 1, 3.
Bars are relative to the largest magnitude shown, so a negative value draws a bar of its size; all zero draws empty bars.
A limit of 0 or less shows every row.
A total smaller than the rows shown adds no "N more".
Long names wrap; the value column keeps its width.

examples.title: Agents by tickets solved
examples.template:
MonarchLeaderboard(
    entries = listOf(
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = {{entries.0.name}}, value = {{entries.0.value|double}}, id = {{entries.0.id}}, change = {{entries.0.change}}),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = {{entries.1.name}}, value = {{entries.1.value|double}}, id = {{entries.1.id}}, change = {{entries.1.change}}, badge = {{entries.1.badge}}, badgeTone = {{entries.1.badgeTone|tone}}),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = {{entries.2.name}}, value = {{entries.2.value|double}}, id = {{entries.2.id}}, current = {{entries.2.current}}),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = {{entries.3.name}}, value = {{entries.3.value|double}}, id = {{entries.3.id}}, secondary = {{entries.3.secondary}}),
    ),
    sort = MonarchBarListSort.Descending,
    label = {{label}},
    valueLabel = {{valueLabel}},
    highlightTop = true,
    limit = {{limit}},
    total = {{total}},
    onShowMore = { /* Open the full report. */ },
)
examples.code:
MonarchLeaderboard(
    entries = listOf(
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = "Ada Moss", value = 64.0, id = "a", change = 0.12),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = "Bea Lund", value = 51.0, id = "b", change = -0.04, badge = "2 breached", badgeTone = MonarchTone.Danger),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = "Cal Ortiz", value = 51.0, id = "c", current = true),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = "Dee Park", value = 38.0, id = "d", secondary = "Billing team"),
    ),
    sort = MonarchBarListSort.Descending,
    label = "Tickets solved this month",
    valueLabel = "tickets solved",
    highlightTop = true,
    limit = 4,
    total = 9,
    onShowMore = { /* Open the full report. */ },
)

examples.title: Fastest teams, smallest first
examples.code:
MonarchLeaderboard(
    entries = listOf(
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = "Billing", value = 4.2, display = "4.2 h", avatarShape = MonarchAvatarShape.Square),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry(name = "Support", value = 6.8, display = "6.8 h", avatarShape = MonarchAvatarShape.Square),
    ),
    sort = MonarchBarListSort.Ascending,
    valueLabel = "to first reply",
    changeGoodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.Down,
)
